worldcombat.skill.infestation.summary: Four clusters of bugs cling and gnaw. The target can move, shedding one cluster after each stretch travelled; fewer remaining clusters means weaker bites.
worldcombat.skill.infestation.descriptio: The hit deals about %1$s special damage and leaves the swarm on the target.

The swarm lasts up to %1$s. While intact, it requests %2$s of maximum health every %3$s; shedding clusters proportionally reduces later bites. Native damage rules settle the loss, and curing the swarm ends it immediately.
Range %1$s blocks, swarm speed %2$s blocks per tick; it attaches to the first target it touches in flight (collision radius %4$s blocks) and scatters if it hits a block first. Wind-up %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.infestation.use.0: Stick a lasting gnaw on a stubborn target
worldcombat.skill.infestation.use.1: Make stationary attackers move to shake off bugs
worldcombat.skill.infestation.use.2: Force the target to clear the status or fight back first
worldcombat.skill.infestation.preference: Within this distance the user considers an Infestation; smaller flings bugs only up close, larger commits from farther away.
On: for a worthwhile target the user leaves its post to close and infest first; Off: only fires in range and holds position.
worldcombat.skill.infestation.timing: Very quick wind-up, short recovery; damage settles in batches while the swarm clings.
worldcombat.skill.infestation.growth.0: From level 30 the initial bite gains another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.infestation.descriptio: Every %1$s blocks actually travelled sheds one of four clusters. Shedding all four clears the swarm.
